features.quote: Termination: 40 tool-use steps or 30 min wall time, whichever comes first.
Cost overrun if any model enters extremely long repetitive loops; add a hard 40-step cap.
features.justification_quote: Cost overrun if any model enters extremely long repetitive loops
Model may discover the planted bug is unfixable and simply stop early

features.quote: Ethical framing: results should be reported as “differential persistence under contradiction,” not “model distress.”
